Installation guide content:
Title Installation and Debugging.
Prerequisites: Node.js v24 or higher (older might work), pnpm, database connection as section Database, docker if using docker installed and running. Links.
Configuration: .env or .env.dev, local dev use .env.dev overwrites default, use env.dev.sample. Optional topic.json, swagger-descprition.md typo. Need config values? It mentions sample file but no explicit values. Database connection needed.
Database: accessible database connection for querying test data. First version PostgreSQL v15 with PostGIS. Sample data in sql/data dump must be imported. Three approaches: own database, tutorial; ensure accessible by host; add params to postgresql.conf/pg_hba.conf; install PostGIS extension; if missing raster create extension; import dump with client. Or installation guide for no admin rights. Or docker environment auto.
Add new database support link.
Installation: pnpm install.
Running app: pnpm run start, start:dev, start:prod. start:prod compile only not start service.
Browser: navigate localhost:3000/api SwaggerUI, api-json.
Test: unit/e2e/coverage.
Docker: possible with Docker/Podman. compose dev creates instance, postgres with PostGIS example data imported, bounding box. pgAdmin included. Two Dockerfiles, compose files. Prereq docker. Default database connection in compose environment properties. docker network encapsulating services, service names, ports exposed.
Run docker compose up. Three containers named. Changes synced volume.
Dev/prod container: compose -f ... up --build.
Troubleshooting: if update package.json, docker files problems, do down -v (deletes manually added database data) then up --build.
Common errors: line ending CRLF error, use LF. TypeORM unable connect, ensure edited .env files, synchronized but read at start, restart container with docker compose up.
PgAdmin4: navigate localhost:5050; add local docker database: register server, connection details: Host db, Port 5432, maintenance postgres, user postgres, password geobakery, save.
